objects.name: Garden plot
moments: Sun caught the edges of the garden flowers before it reached the wooden bench.
Robin and I knelt beside the raised bed, planting three little seedlings under the apple tree.
I left the watering can by the path and sat on the bench with my notebook until the soil on my gloves dried.
